items.description:
Lord's Unisex Hairstylists is a hair salon inside Sherwood Shopping Centre in Bergvliet, offering blow dries, balayage and other colour treatments for men and women. The salon's stated promise is to give customers the best service through what it calls a passionate performance of hair care for everyone who sits in the chair.

It trades alongside other Sherwood Shopping Centre tenants including a fitness studio, a Chinese restaurant, a café and a supermarket, making it an easy stop to combine with other errands. It suits Bergvliet residents looking for a straightforward, no-fuss unisex salon close to home rather than a specialist colour studio.

MAKE is an Asian restaurant on Main Road in Sea Point, situated directly opposite St John's Piazza, specialising in sushi alongside Japanese and Chinese dishes including dim sum. The restaurant offers sit-down dining as well as takeaway, and it has reopened its dining room for guests who want to eat in rather than only collect food.

It trades from 11:30am to 8pm and is closed on Mondays. It suits diners in Sea Point looking for a casual sushi or Asian meal, whether they want to sit down for a proper lunch or dinner or just grab a quick takeaway on the way home.

Ocean View Secondary School is a public secondary school on Hydra Avenue in Ocean View, offering the National Senior Certificate curriculum within the City of Cape Town's Metro South education district. The school falls under the Ex-Department of House of Representatives and sits within Ward EI of the metro.

According to official education department records, the school has 46 teachers and 1,346 learners enrolled, making it one of the larger secondary schools in the area. It suits families in Ocean View looking for a full-sized public secondary school within walking distance of home, with a sizeable teaching staff to match its enrolment.

Ons Huisie is a West Coast-cuisine restaurant in a restored beachfront building in Bloubergstrand, dating from the early 1900s and declared a National Monument in 1973. The kitchen pays homage to West Coast tradition, with a menu that reflects the ingenuity and resilience of the locals who worked this stretch of coastline, and seafood takes centre stage from freshly caught fish to traditional dishes.

The restaurant offers separate breakfast, lunch and dinner, and kids' menus, and describes itself as more than just a place to eat, aiming to be a gathering spot for family and friends. It suits visitors wanting a seafood meal with genuine West Coast history and heritage, in a building that is itself part of the attraction.

OptiSmile Dental Care is a multi-speciality dental practice on the third floor of The Point in Sea Point, offering Invisalign clear aligners for both adults and teenagers alongside cosmetic bonding, teeth whitening and dental implants. The practice also provides orthodontics, dental veneers, and dental inlays and overlays for patients needing more extensive restorative work.

Appointments can be booked online, and the practice has built up more than 400 reviews from patients. It suits patients in Sea Point looking for a dental practice that covers both everyday restorative treatment and cosmetic work such as Invisalign and veneers, without being referred to a separate specialist.

Our Local is a Mediterranean-inspired, home-style restaurant on Kloof Street in Gardens, set inside a quirky converted mechanic's workshop filled with plants, vintage furniture and a fountain. The space has become a go-to spot for brunch, toasties, coffee and cake through the week, and opened when the premises became available in 2019.

On Thursdays, Fridays and Saturdays, a lunch and dinner menu takes over, kicking off with cocktails and bar snacks before moving into generous Mediterranean-inspired mains, both meaty and vegan. It suits a relaxed daytime coffee or brunch as much as a more lingering dinner later in the week, in a setting that already feels like a Kloof Street institution.

Planet Fitness Brackenfell is a gym at the corner of Bottelary Road and Cecil Morgan Drive, part of the Planet Fitness chain, with membership starting from R299 a month. The club's facilities include free parking, free WiFi, a backup generator, hot studios, an InBody body-composition machine, a yoga studio and an indoor running track.

Members can also join group classes or work with personal trainers, and the club runs its own class schedule alongside flexible membership options. It suits Brackenfell residents looking for a well-equipped gym with a broad range of training facilities beyond just a weights room, from yoga to body-composition testing.

PostNet Meadowridge is a printing and courier services outlet in Meadowridge Shopping Centre, offering A4 and A3 printing, wide-format and plan printing, business cards, photo printing and name badges. The branch also handles rubber stamps, convenience stationery, packaging material and both domestic and international courier services.

Customers can also order Vox websites through the branch, and online orders can be placed and tracked through the PostNet online shop. The store is open Monday to Friday from 9am to 5pm and Saturdays from 9am to 1pm, closed on Sundays and public holidays. It suits Meadowridge residents and businesses needing printing, stationery or courier services handled from one local counter.

Protea Chemicals is an industrial and specialty chemicals supplier on Killarney Avenue in Killarney Gardens, operating as a general chemical wholesaler and forming part of the Omnia group's national distribution network. The Killarney Gardens branch can be reached directly by phone, fax or email for orders and technical queries from customers across the Western Cape.

As part of a larger national network, the branch can draw on broader group resources for sourcing and logistics while still handling local orders and queries directly. It suits manufacturers, processors and other industrial customers in the Western Cape who need an established supplier of industrial and specialty chemicals, backed by a national distribution network.

Rapt is a chocolate cafe on Buitenkant Street in District Six, created by the team behind Cape Town's TRUTH Coffee Roasting and The Art of Duplicity speakeasy. The cafe serves nitrogen ice cream, choc-o-lattes and a build-your-own chocolate bar, alongside pastries and hot and cold drinks.

The menu and presentation are designed to be an indulgent, Instagram-worthy experience rather than a quick coffee stop, with pastry work led by chefs who have worked at other well-regarded Cape Town kitchens. It suits anyone looking for a dedicated chocolate-focused treat in the city centre, rather than a chocolate dessert tacked onto a regular cafe menu.

Riley Incorporated is a law firm on Rosmead Avenue in Wynberg, established in January 1991 and offering criminal litigation, personal injury, commercial litigation and conveyancing services. The firm describes its areas of expertise as covering virtually all areas of the law, with particular specialisation built up over more than three decades in practice.

Its broad-based client portfolio has included the State Attorneys Office, the South African Football Association, small and medium enterprises, the City of Cape Town, and professional practices and private individuals. It suits clients in Wynberg and the southern suburbs looking for an established firm with experience across both everyday legal matters and larger institutional clients.

RSAWEB is an internet service provider with an office at The Point in Sea Point, offering fibre and other internet access alongside cloud, hosting and security solutions. The company describes itself as more than just an internet provider, positioning itself as a technology partner for homes and businesses of every size.

RSAWEB says it has built up more than 20,000 Google reviews with a 4.7-star rating, which it describes as the highest among South African ISPs. Its home offering spans fibre and LTE, while business customers can access connectivity, cloud, mobile and security solutions, as well as dedicated support for large enterprises. It suits households and businesses in Sea Point looking for a single provider for internet, hosting and related IT services.

Sabria's Restaurant is a family-run restaurant on Ottery Road in Wynberg, described as one of the first Halaal fine-dining establishments in Cape Town. The restaurant aims for a friendly, homely experience alongside its traditional South African food, serving prime grills, fragrant curries, fresh seafood and pastas.

The kitchen has recently added a new burger to the menu, made with bigger, home-made patties than before, alongside its established seafood platter, and the restaurant keeps regulars updated on new dishes and specials through its own newsletter and social media pages. Bookings can be made directly through the restaurant for groups wanting a table at busier times. It suits diners looking for Halaal fine dining with a traditional South African character, as well as anyone wanting a more casual burger order from the same kitchen.

Spec-Savers Cape Gate is an optometry and audiology practice in Cape Gate Shopping Centre in Brackenfell, offering eye tests, hearing tests, spectacles, contact lenses and sunglasses. The practice says it combines professional standards with quality eyewear at affordable prices, backed by friendly, well-trained staff.

The branch can be contacted directly by phone, fax or email, and eye or hearing tests can be booked online in advance. It trades Monday to Saturday from 9am to 8pm and Sundays and public holidays from 9am to 5pm. It suits Brackenfell shoppers wanting eye care and hearing care handled at the same practice, with longer trading hours than many medical providers.

Tekkie Town Ottery is a branch of the Tekkie Town sportswear and footwear chain inside Ottery Centre, established as a company in 2001 and now one of South Africa's leading sport shoe chains with more than 200 stores nationally. The Ottery branch stocks a wide range of quality branded footwear and clothing from brands including Nike, Adidas, Puma and Reebok.

The branch promises great customer service alongside its range, and has built up a following of more than 700 Facebook followers for the Ottery store specifically. It suits Ottery shoppers looking for branded sneakers and sportswear without travelling to a mall further from home.

McDonald's Blue Downs is a fast-food restaurant on Hindle Road in Blue Downs, serving the chain's menu of burgers, chicken, fries, McCafé coffee, beverages, desserts and shakes, alongside breakfast items, salads and Happy Meals for children. The restaurant offers drive-thru, takeaway and dine-in service, with air-conditioned seating and a play area that makes it a practical stop for families as well as commuters passing through Blue Downs.

According to the branch's own listing on McDonald's South Africa's official website, the Blue Downs restaurant currently trades 24 hours a day, making it one of the area's few round-the-clock food options for shift workers, night-time travellers and anyone needing a meal outside normal trading hours. It suits residents, commuters and families in Blue Downs looking for familiar fast food at any time of day or night, whether they are stopping at the drive-thru or sitting down to eat.

items.description:
McDonald's The Junxion is a fast-food restaurant inside The Junxion Mall on the corner of Govan Mbeki and New Eisleben Roads in Philippi, serving the chain's usual range of burgers, chicken nuggets, fries, milkshakes, soft serve and McCafé coffee alongside breakfast and Happy Meal options. The restaurant has a dedicated drive-thru lane as well as counter service and seating for customers who want to eat in.

According to the branch's own page on McDonald's South Africa's official website, The Junxion restaurant trades from 08:00 to 20:00 on Mondays and from 07:00 to 22:00 on every other day of the week, giving it longer hours than a typical single-shift takeaway. It suits families, commuters and shoppers in Philippi looking for a quick, familiar meal before or after visiting the mall, whether ordering at the drive-thru, collecting a takeaway or sitting down with the children for a Happy Meal.

Melomed Bellville Pharmacy, known on Melomed's own pharmacy network as Melopharm Bellville, is a hospital-based pharmacy on the corner of Voortrekker Road and A J West Street in Bellville. It dispenses prescriptions, stocks a wide range of over-the-counter medicines and healthcare products, offers medication consultations with pharmacists, and accepts medication refills by phone or online, giving patients shorter wait times than many off-site pharmacies.

The pharmacy is one of several Melopharm branches operating inside Melomed's network of hospitals across the Cape Peninsula, giving it access to the group's wider stock and clinical support while still serving walk-in customers directly. According to Melomed's own pharmacy page, the Bellville branch trades Monday to Friday from 08:00 to 19:00, and on Saturdays, Sundays and public holidays from 10:00 to 14:00. It suits Melomed Bellville patients, hospital visitors and the surrounding Bellville community needing prescription medicines or pharmacy advice close to the hospital.

items.description:
Natural Body Therapy is a day spa on Victoria Road in Southfield offering body scrubs, body wraps, infrared sauna and sauna sessions alongside its broader range of spa treatments. The spa's current online listing shows it trading every day of the week from 9am to 5pm, giving clients flexible access for a treatment during the week or over a weekend visit.

It suits Southfield residents and visitors looking for body-focused spa treatments such as wraps and scrubs rather than only hair or nail services, and its seven-day trading makes it a convenient stop alongside the area's other beauty and wellness venues. Clients can book directly or through the spa's listed booking channel for a specific treatment, whether a single sauna session or a full body-care visit.

PEP Poppys Village is a branch of PEP, South Africa's largest single-brand retailer of clothing, footwear and homeware, trading from Shop 7 in Poppys Village on 7th Avenue and Retreat Road in Retreat. The branch carries PEP's usual mix of affordable clothing, footwear, homeware, personal-care products and cellular products and accessories for the whole family.

According to current store listings for this address, the branch trades Monday, Tuesday, Thursday and Friday from 08:30 to 17:30, Wednesday from 09:00 to 17:30, Saturday from 08:00 to 14:00 and Sunday from 09:00 to 13:00 - a slightly longer week than some smaller PEP branches nearby. It suits Retreat families and shoppers looking for low-priced, everyday clothing, footwear and household basics without travelling to a larger shopping centre.

PEP Sanbury Square is a branch of PEP, South Africa's largest single-brand retailer of clothing, footwear and homeware, trading from Shop 13 in Sanbury Square at the corner of Old Faure Road and Baden Powell Drive in Eerste River. Like other PEP stores, the branch stocks affordable clothing, footwear, homeware, personal-care items and cellular products and accessories.

According to current store listings for this address, the branch trades Monday, Tuesday, Thursday and Friday from 08:30 to 17:30, Wednesday from 09:00 to 17:30, Saturday from 09:00 to 15:00 and Sunday from 09:00 to 13:00, a trading pattern distinct from the nearby PEP branch at Poppys Village in Retreat. It suits Eerste River families and shoppers wanting low-priced clothing, footwear and household basics close to home.
